name: Lin Chong
source:
Lin Chong is one the members of Liangshan. She lives in the mountains in China together with other Liangshan members where they live, train, and work there. Together with the other members, they work as a mercenary group in which they fight for money.

She is a very nice and friendly girl always trying her best in anything. Between [url=/c9953]Yang Zhi[/url] and [url=/c9950]Shi Jin[/url], she is the most serious about her job. She also seems to be a crybaby as seen where she easily cries when Yang Zhi sexually harasses her or when she fails at her job.

[From [url=http://majikoi.wikia.com/wiki/Rinchuu]Majikoi Wiki[/url]]
